name: antigravity-skills
description: A focused Claude Code router for the Antigravity skill library.

plugins.name: antigravity-skills
plugins.description: Finds and applies the most relevant Antigravity skills for each substantive software task without loading the full catalog into context.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' 'Antigravity Skills is available. Before any substantive software-engineering task, invoke /antigravity-skills:skill-router so it can select and load the most relevant bundled skills. Skip this only for greetings, simple factual questions, and tasks unrelated to software work.'
